name: sandforge
description: Salesforce Sandbox ETL Toolkit for VSCode

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sandforge/shared build && pnpm --filter {./packages/extension} build && pnpm --filter @sandforge/webview build && pnpm run copy:webview
scripts.validate: pnpm build:shared && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.package: pnpm build && cd packages/extension && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o ../../sandforge.vsix
